# Northwind

Northwind is a cutting-edge platform that lets teams utilize their content across every channel.

events.text:
**25 / 100**

`voice.yaml` defines no weights or rubric, so I scored it on the three sections it does define — vocabulary 40%, tone 30%, style 30%:

| Section | Score | Findings |
|---|---|---|
| Vocabulary | 0 / 40 | `cutting-edge` (major) and `utilize` (major) — two forbidden terms in a 14-word sentence. `utilize` also has an explicit preferred replacement: `use`. |
| Tone | 10 / 30 | Fails `plain` and the "no marketing superlatives" guideline — "cutting-edge platform… every channel" is pure marketing. Formality and humor (none) pass. |
| Style | 15 / 30 | `active_voice` passes. `person_pov: second` fails — it's third person ("teams… their"), and the guidelines explicitly say address the reader as you. `sentence_length: short` is borderline at 14 words of stacked qualifiers. |

The two major vocabulary hits are the dominant penalty; the third-person framing is the next biggest gap. A compliant rewrite would be roughly: "Northwind lets you use your content across every channel."
